violated_contract: A capture health surface that reports listening or capturing must not claim speech is flowing when the sole speech path is permanently stopped (paywalled, auth-refused, or otherwise non-retrying). Permanent speech denial must surface as an explicit per-source reason; a healthy empty transcript is not an allowed presentation of that state.
canonical_prevention: Map the speech transport's durable failure states onto the same per-source reason channel as mic/screen at one shared classification (not at each UI), and assert paywall/permanent-failure/signed-out cases never clear that reason while capture remains unpaused.
